recipes.cooking_instructions: Slice chicken and vegetables. Toss with oil and spices. Roast at 210C for 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through. Warm tortillas and serve with lime. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.
recipes.ingredient_notes: 350 g chicken breast; 2 each red pepper; 1 each brown onion; 4 each tortillas; 2.4 g smoked paprika; 2 g cumin; 1 each lime; 15 ml oil

recipes.cooking_instructions: Brown beef with onion and carrot. Add tomato puree and stock; simmer 15 minutes, then peas. Boil and mash potatoes with butter. Top beef and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.
recipes.ingredient_notes: 300 g beef mince; 450 g potatoes for mash or roasting; 1 each brown onion; 200 g carrot; 120 g peas; 16 g tomato puree/paste; 0.5 cube beef stock mix; 20 g butter

recipes.cooking_instructions: Bake potatoes at 200C for 50-60 minutes. Brown mince and onion; add spices, beans and tomatoes. Simmer 25 minutes and spoon over split potatoes. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.
recipes.ingredient_notes: 300 g beef mince; 2 each large baking potato; 1 each brown onion; 240 g kidney beans; 400 g chopped tomatoes; 2 g cumin; 2.4 g smoked paprika; 6 g red chilli

recipes.recipe_name: Sweet potato and black bean enchiladas
recipes.cooking_instructions: Roast cubed sweet potato at 200C for 20 minutes. Mix with beans, onion and spices; roll in tortillas. Cover with passata and cheese; bake 20 minutes until bubbling. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.
recipes.ingredient_notes: 450 g sweet potato; 240 g canned black beans (drained); 4 each tortillas; 300 g passata; 100 g cheddar; 1 each brown onion; 2 g cumin; 2.4 g smoked paprika; 10 ml oil

recipes.cooking_instructions: Cook noodles. Brown mushrooms and onion, add paprika and flour. Stir in stock and simmer 5 minutes; turn heat low and stir in sour cream and mustard. Serve over noodles. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.
recipes.ingredient_notes: 350 g mushrooms; 180 g dried egg noodles; 1 each brown onion; 150 ml sour cream; 5 g mustard; 0.5 cube vegetable stock mix; 2.4 g smoked paprika; 8 g flour; 10 ml oil

recipes.cooking_instructions: Bake potatoes at 200C for 50-60 minutes until tender. Mix drained tuna, sweetcorn and mayonnaise. Split potatoes, fill and top with cheese; serve with cucumber and tomato. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.
recipes.ingredient_notes: 2 each large baking potato; 145 g tinned tuna (drained); 120 g sweetcorn; 60 ml mayonnaise; 40 g cheddar; 0.5 each cucumber; 120 g tomatoes

recipes.cooking_instructions: Soften onion and carrot; add lentils, tomato puree, stock and peas. Simmer until thick. Boil and mash potatoes with butter, spread over filling and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Use the quantities in recipe_ingredients.csv; water for cooking is not a purchased ingredient.
recipes.ingredient_notes: 240 g canned lentils (drained); 450 g potatoes for mash or roasting; 1 each brown onion; 200 g carrot; 120 g peas; 0.5 cube vegetable stock mix; 16 g tomato puree/paste; 20 g butter
